scientific_choices.choice: Frozen upstream word-spotting evaluator specifies MIN_LENGTH_CARE_WORD=3, but its full care, polygon, numeric and transcription rules are separate. Reuse unchanged saved DeepSolo predictions, previously TRAIN-selected native/global policies and original ignore/envelope flags.

User-requested length-only diagnostic removes normalized strings shorter than three characters independently from GT and predictions. Digits remain allowed; no GT-overlap neutralization is introduced. Preserve all 300 images including images with no remaining care words. Do not retune or select a profile on TEST. This explicitly changes the evaluated word population and does not replace historical results.

This symmetric length-filtered local metric is not official Total-Text word spotting and cannot establish reproduction of the published83.6% F1. Full official GT/polygon/ignore/transcription equivalence remains unresolved.
